posts.cooked:
I noticed that backlash field seems to have been significantly nerfed in the enhanced edition by removing the second paragraph. In any case, how is it actually supposed to work on the 1st edition version? For reference:" Whenever Baron Blade is delt 5 or more damage in a single turn, put the top card of the villain deck into the villan trash."

If during my turn I deal 3 packets of damage (5-1-1) when exactly will the effect trigger?

(1) Just once, after dealing 5 damage, because I delt 5 damage.

(2) Just once, at the end of my turn, because I delt 7 damage

(3) Three times: after dealing the first packet of 5 damage (I inflicted 5 damage this turn so the effect triggers), then again after dealing the second damage packet (I inflicted 6 damage this turn so the effect triggers again), and again one last time after the last packet for the same reason.

I usually just did (1), but began wondering if (3) isn't actually the right answer (i guess maybe 2 is possible, although it seems unlikely to me).

Thanks
